name: Oil Slick Iridescence
recipe: Thin-film interference iridescence: a slowly-warping height/thickness field maps to soft-interference spectral colors (like oil on water / soap film / beetle shell). Domain-warp a coarse buffer, map thickness->iridescent hue via cos-interference. Continuous warp drift = motion.
kernel: per-pixel coarse buffer (~200): warp a height field, thickness->interference RGB (cos of thickness*freq per channel offset)
style: oil-on-water (default, dark iridescent). Also: soap-film pastel, beetle-shell metallic, thermal, nacre pearlescent.

name: Murmuration
recipe: Reynolds boids murmuration: 200-400 agents with separation/alignment/cohesion + a wandering attractor, leaving motion-blur trails on a fade buffer -> starling-flock ribbons that swirl and split. Speed maps to hue. Predator disturbance on bass.
kernel: agent sim (arrays in S) + spatial-hash neighbors + fade trail buffer; draw agents as short streaks
style: ink-flock (default, dark birds on pale sky). Also: neon-vector, thermal-density, blueprint-vectors, dusk-silhouette.

name: Escape-Time Fractal
recipe: Mandelbrot/Julia escape-time on a coarse buffer with smooth (continuous) iteration coloring; the Julia c-parameter orbits a slow circle and a gentle zoom breathes so the fractal endlessly morphs. Interior orbit-trap accent.
kernel: per-pixel coarse buffer (~200): iterate z=z^2+c, smooth-iter -> palette; animate c on K.t/K.section
style: ember (default, warm smooth-iter). Also: electric-blue, grayscale-engraving, thermal, psychedelic-cycled.

name: Penrose Tiling
recipe: Penrose P3 rhombus tiling by deflation (subdivide fat/thin rhombs a few generations, seeded) -> aperiodic 5-fold quasilattice. A glow-front sweeps the tiles on K.t and tiles flip color by section; 5-fold rosettes emerge. Different from truchet/girih.
kernel: geometry: deflation subdivision into a tile list (rebuild on seed/section), draw filled rhombs + edges; ~<=1500 tiles
style: gilt-manuscript (default). Also: blueprint schematic, neon strapwork, riso duotone, sumi-ink.

name: Dielectric Lightning
recipe: Dielectric-breakdown / Lichtenberg branching: grow a branching electric discharge tree from a seed toward random targets (fractal branching), the freshest branches flaring bright then fading; re-strike each section. Read research/generative/techniques/growth_systems.md.
kernel: growth: maintain a branch list, extend toward biased-random points, draw glowing segments w/ shadowBlur on the tips; fade trail buffer
style: electric-plasma (default, blue-white bolts on dark). Also: lichtenberg-amber (frozen), schematic-wiring, nerve-red, thermal.

name: Elementary CA Spacetime
recipe: 1D elementary cellular automaton (Rule 30/90/110/etc, rule steps by section) evolved row by row and SCROLLED upward so the spacetime diagram continuously streams -> Wolfram triangles/fractals. Scroll = motion floor. Different from 2D life (genart.cellular).
kernel: 1D state row + append new row each K.t step, scroll a buffer up by 1, draw new row; rule as a lookup
style: phosphor-terminal (default, green on black). Also: ink-on-paper, amber-CRT, blueprint, thermal-heat.

name: Ink Fluid
recipe: Stam stable-fluids dye advection on a coarse grid: a velocity field (curl-noise + beat impulses) advects a dye field semi-Lagrangianly; dye diffuses+fades. Read research/generative/techniques/stable_fluids.md. Blooming smoke/ink in water.
kernel: coarse grid (~120) velocity(u,v)+dye buffers; semi-Lagrangian advect (bilinear backtrace); upscale
style: ink-in-water (default, dark pigment blooming). Also: luminous-smoke, thermal-schlieren, spectral-velocity, blueprint-vectors.

name: Fractal Flame
recipe: IFS fractal flame chaos-game: iterate points through a set of affine+nonlinear (sinusoidal/spherical/swirl) variations, accumulate into a coarse log-density buffer, gamma tone-map through an electric-sheep palette. Variation weights drift by section -> the flame morphs. Read research/generative/techniques/ifs_flame.md.
kernel: chaos-game point accumulation into a density Float buffer each frame (~15-30k pts), log-gamma -> color, upscale additive
style: electric-sheep (default, glowing). Also: sumi-ink, thermal, iridescent, monochrome-engraving.

name: CMYK Halftone
recipe: CMYK halftone print: a drifting domain-warp source separated into C/M/Y/K channels, each screened as rotated dot grids (15/75/0/45 deg) -> moiré rosette print texture. Dot size = channel value. Source drift + slight screen rotation = motion. Different from dither(Bayer 1-bit).
kernel: draw 4 rotated dot-grid layers (variable dot radius from a coarse source) with MULTIPLY-ish overlay; keep dots <=~2000 total or use per-pixel screen
style: cmyk-print (default, newsprint rosette). Also: 2-color riso, monochrome-halftone, pop-art bold, thermal.

name: Kaleidoscope
recipe: Live kaleidoscope: a particle/ink emitter feeds a buffer that is mirror-folded into N-fold radial symmetry each frame (rotate+reflect wedges) with a slow feedback zoom -> endlessly blooming symmetric mandala-in-motion. Symmetry order N steps by section. Different from mandala (static construct) and feedback_paint.
kernel: emitter draws into a wedge of a buffer; composite N rotated+mirrored copies; slight feedback zoom/fade
style: jewel (default, saturated symmetric bloom). Also: sumi-ink, neon, stained-glass, pastel-dream.
